title: Structural Reductions for Monochromatic Matchings and Ramsey Tilings
summary: The Alon--Frankl--Lovász theorem determines the chromatic number of Kneser hypergraphs; equivalently, it gives the sharp minimum size of a monochromatic matching in every edge-colouring of a complete uniform hypergraph. Its known general proofs are topological. We introduce a topology-free structural framework. It reduces every colouring of a pseudorandom $t$-graph, with only $o(n)$ loss in the largest monochromatic matching, to a colouring of $K_n^{(t)}$ whose vertex set has at most $r$ parts and whose edge colours depend only on intersection profiles.
